title: Beginning, Middle and Ending Sounds
introduction: Practise beginning, middle and ending sounds with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Words are made of sounds. Listen for the first, middle and last sounds in short words.
rules: Listen to words containing different middle vowel sounds: bag, bed, big, bog, bug.
A word can have several letters representing a single sound. Listen rather than simply count letters.
Change one sound to make a new word: cat, cap, map.
Recognise and name upper-case and lower-case letters. Say their common sounds separately from their letter names.

examples.question: What is the first sound in van?
steps: Say van slowly and listen at the beginning.

examples.question: What is the middle vowel in bed?
steps: The short e sound is between b and d.

examples.question: Which word ends with the same sound as cup: map or cat?
Change the first sound of pan to /m/.
Change the last sound of pin to /g/.

exercises.question: First letter of goat?
exercises.solution: Look at the letter before oa in goat.

exercises.question: Middle letter in hen?
exercises.solution: Hen has three letters; identify the second letter.

exercises.question: Last letter of lamp?
exercises.solution: Look at the letter after m in lamp.

exercises.question: Middle letter in pig?
exercises.solution: Pig has three letters; identify the vowel between p and g.

exercises.question: Last letter in van?
exercises.solution: Look at the letter after a in van.

exercises.question: First letter in leaf?
exercises.solution: Look at the letter before ea in leaf.

exercises.question: Change the first letter of bat to m.
exercises.solution: Replace b with m and keep at unchanged.

exercises.question: Change the last letter of bag to t.
exercises.solution: Replace g with t and keep ba unchanged.

exercises.question: Which ends like dog: frog or fish?
exercises.solution: Dog and frog share the same final -og sound.

exercises.question: Which has the same middle vowel as cup: bus or bed?
exercises.solution: Cup and bus both contain the short u sound.

exercises.question: Which lower-case letter matches B?
exercises.solution: Change the capital letter B to its small form.

exercises.question: Which capital letter matches m?
exercises.solution: Change the small letter m to its capital form.

exercises.question: Which letter begins sun?
exercises.solution: Listen for the /s/ sound at the beginning of sun.

summary: Words are made of sounds. Listen for the first, middle and last sounds in short words.
